channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2013-3163 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause a denial of service via a crafted website.

item.title: CVE-2022-27518 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway, when configured with SAML SP or IdP configuration, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code as administrator.

item.title: CVE-2023-29492 — Novi Survey Novi Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Novi Survey contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the server in the context of the service account.

item.title: CVE-2022-42948 — Fortra Cobalt Strike
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Fortra Cobalt Strike User Interface contains an unspecified vulnerability rooted in Java Swing that may allow remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-5430 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 68. TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

item.title: CVE-2022-26500 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 69. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2021-27878 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a command execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to use a data management protocol command to execute a command on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2023-2033 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-21674 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-2136 — Google Chromium Skia
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

item.title: CVE-2023-22952 — SugarCRM Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 74. Multiple SugarCRM products contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the EmailTemplates. Using a specially crafted request, custom PHP code can be injected through the EmailTemplates.

item.title: CVE-2021-27876 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2022-3038 — Google Chromium Network Service
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium Network Service contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-28205 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2022-38181 — Arm Mali Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that may allow a non-privileged user to gain root privilege and/or disclose information.

item.title: CVE-2017-6742 — Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software
item.description: Threat Signal 62. The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code on an affected system or cause an affected system to reload.

item.title: CVE-2023-23376 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-2291 — Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2019-1388 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Windows Certificate Dialog contains a privilege escalation vulnerability, allowing attackers to run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2023-32373 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-23529 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, MacOS, Safari and iPadOS WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2022-42856 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution.

item.title: CVE-2023-2868 — Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) appliance contains an improper input validation vulnerability of a user-supplied .tar file, leading to remote command injection.

item.title: CVE-2016-3427 — Oracle Java SE and JRockit
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Oracle Java SE and JRockit contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via vectors related to Java Management Extensions (JMX). This vulnerability can be exploited through sandboxed Java Web Start applications and sandboxed Java applets. It can also be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified component without using sandboxed Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, such as through a web service.

item.title: CVE-2016-8735 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 78. Apache Tomcat contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution if JmxRemoteLifecycleListener is used and an attacker can reach Java Management Extension (JMX) ports. This CVE exists because this listener wasn't updated for consistency with the Oracle patched issues for CVE-2016-3427 which affected credential types.

item.title: CVE-2023-29336 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation up to SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-28206 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS IOSurfaceAccelerator contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows an app to execute code with kernel privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-32409 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that can allow a remote attacker to break out of the Web Content sandbox. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-23397 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows for a NTLM Relay attack against another service to authenticate as the user.

item.title: CVE-2022-41223 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Director component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute code within the context of the application.

item.title: CVE-2022-40765 — Mitel MiVoice Connect
item.description: Threat Signal 66. The Mitel Edge Gateway component of MiVoice Connect allows an authenticated attacker with internal network access to execute commands within the context of the system.

item.title: CVE-2022-28810 — Zoho ManageEngine
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing for remote code execution when performing a password change or reset.

item.title: CVE-2021-3560 — Red Hat Polkit
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2016-6415 — Cisco IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Cisco IOS, IOS XR, and IOS XE contain insufficient condition checks in the part of the code that handles Internet Key Exchange version 1 (IKEv1) security negotiation requests. contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the Internet Key Exchange version 1 (IKEv1) that could allow an attacker to retrieve memory contents. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to retrieve memory contents, which can lead to information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2023-28432 — MinIO MinIO
item.description: Threat Signal 72. MinIO contains a vulnerability in a cluster deployment where MinIO returns all environment variables, which allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2020-5741 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Plex Media Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker with access to the server administrator's Plex account to upload a malicious file via the Camera Upload feature and have the media server execute it.

item.title: CVE-2022-33891 — Apache Spark
item.description: Threat Signal 77. Apache Spark contains a command injection vulnerability via Spark User Interface (UI) when Access Control Lists (ACLs) are enabled.

item.title: CVE-2022-39197 — Fortra Cobalt Strike
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Fortra Cobalt Strike contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Teamserver that would allow an attacker to set a malformed username in the Beacon configuration, allowing them to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2018-18809 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 69. TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

item.title: CVE-2023-26360 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-35914 — Teclib GLPI
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Teclib GLPI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the third-party library, htmlawed.

item.title: CVE-2022-46169 — Cacti Cacti
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Cacti contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2022-44877 — CWP Control Web Panel
item.description: Threat Signal 80. CWP Control Web Panel (formerly CentOS Web Panel) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute commands via shell metacharacters in the login parameter.

item.title: CVE-2023-28771 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Zyxel ATP, USG FLEX, VPN, and ZyWALL/USG firewalls allow for improper error message handling which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute OS commands remotely by sending crafted packets to an affected device.

item.title: CVE-2023-25717 — Ruckus Wireless Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 80. Ruckus Wireless Access Point (AP) software contains an unspecified vulnerability in the web services component. If the web services component is enabled on the AP, an attacker can perform cross-site request forgery (CSRF) or remote code execution (RCE). This vulnerability impacts Ruckus ZoneDirector, SmartZone, and Solo APs.

item.title: CVE-2010-3904 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Linux Kernel contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Reliable Datagram Sockets (RDS) protocol implementation that allows local users to gain privileges via crafted use of the sendmsg and recvmsg system calls.

item.title: CVE-2021-27877 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

item.title: CVE-2015-5317 — Jenkins Jenkins User Interface (UI)
item.description: Threat Signal 59. Jenkins User Interface (UI) contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users to see the names of jobs and builds otherwise inaccessible to them on the "Fingerprints" pages.

item.title: CVE-2019-8526 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Apple macOS contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-20963 — Android Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation after updating an app to a higher Target SDK with no additional execution privileges needed.
